title: Simple, intuitive and useful
body:
Simple, intuitive and useful. 

One criticism is that a reset is a reset. There is no options for in between. 

You can start multiple counters to fix this, but I have sometimes had around 12 different counters referring to 3 or 4 habits. 

Overall a good app, and although I’d like to see this improved, not at the risk of sacrificing its current intuitive simplicity. 

Slightly buggy at times if you’re setting a counter for something in the past. 

Ex.) let’s say I quit drinking as an example. Let’s say I did it 2 days ago, but if I were just to download the app to track this I would not be able to set it back to when I actually started the streak. 

It is closer to 5 stars than 4, which is why I am giving it a 5 star rating.
